description: Three-page German IT maintenance services contract (Dienstleistungsvertrag) between two fictitious companies, typeset with Typst 0.15 with German hyphenation of long compounds, „“ quotes, umlauts and ß, small-caps party names, § clause numbering and two footnotes. Edits: the contract start date, the response time for critical faults, the monthly flat fee, a data-loss liability limitation deleted, a survival sentence inserted in the confidentiality clause, the written-form clause underlined, and the draft date in the running header on every page (one furniture item per page). Consequences only: paragraphs in § 7 and § 8 re-flow, hyphenation points move (e.g. 'fahrläs-siger', 'vor-hersehbaren'), and the governing-law paragraph moves from the top of page 3 to the end of page 2, leaving only the signature block on page 3. Producer: Typst 0.15.0 (Python package typst 0.15.0), fonts embedded in the PDF: Libertinus Serif Regular and Bold (bundled with Typst). Synthetic sample: all parties, places and figures are fictitious.
